liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Estimated Prophet** (2 reviews): Estimated Prophet into Eyes of the World is called unbelievable; Reviewer especially enjoys the Estimated Prophet into Eyes transition [16][17]
- **Eyes Of The World** (2 reviews): Spectacular Eyes with great Brent and Jerry interplay around the 18-minute mark; Eyes follows a solid Estimated, has a beautiful closing jam, and runs nearly 20 minutes; among the better versions [12][14]
- **Mexicali Blues** (1 review): Mexicali Blues includes a tease of Blackbird [16]
- **Brown Eyed Women** (1 review): Brown Eyed Women and Looks Like Rain are singled out as standout versions [18]
- **Shakedown Street** (1 review): Shakedown is very tight, one of the nicer jamming versions [12]
- **Samson And Delilah** (1 review): Jerry lets go with fast, driven noodling during Samson and also in Eyes [18]
- **High Time** (1 review): A second-set High Time is singled out as a highlight of the setlist [9]
- **Around And Around** (1 review): Bobby starts off-key and the song never recovers; reviewer calls it a disaster [14]

## The recordings

- **gd1979-11-29.sbd.miller.95831.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 21 songs; 168 min; rated 4.09/5 by 11 [1]. Said about its sound: Clear, crisp soundboard with Phil upfront and driving, with good depth [15]
- **gd79-11-29.sbd.miller.29421.sbeok.flacf**: soundboard; 21 songs; 170 min; rated 4/5 by 3 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer describes the soundboard sound as great [14]
- **gd79-11-29.sbd.clugston.12376.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 22 songs; 156 min; rated 3.9/5 by 10 [3]. Said about its sound: Reviewer notes the Not Fade Away is cut from this soundboard recording; Very fine soundboard with a super mix; every instrument is defined and crisp [9][10]
- **gd1979-11-29.151720.1.2p.fob.shure.sm57.sublette.mattes.miller.clugston.flac1648**: audience recording; 13 songs; 86 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [4]
- **gd1979-11-29.set2.sbd.jim.11630.shnf**: soundboard; 10 songs; 92 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [6]. Said about its sound: The opening note or two of Shakedown Street is cut; First disc is short so Estimated through Johnny B. Goode continues unbroken on disc 2 [6]

## Around the show

- Counted as another strong example of the Fall 1979 run; first set smokes, second set steps it up [15]
- This was the first audience source of the show in general circulation [4]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1979-11-29.sbd.miller.95831.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Sony TCD5M/UDXL-II) -> Dat (Panasonic SV3800/48k) [1]. Also: This is a remaster of the earlier Miller transfer, with pitch correction help from Joe B. Jones [1]
- **gd79-11-29.sbd.miller.29421.sbeok.flacf**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Soundboard [2]. Also: Soundboard to cassette master (Sony TCD5M, UDXL-II), then to DAT via Panasonic SV3800 at 48k; transferred and edited by Charlie Miller [2]
- **gd79-11-29.sbd.clugston.12376.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [3]
- **gd1979-11-29.151720.1.2p.fob.shure.sm57.sublette.mattes.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Kathy Sublette; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Kathy Sublette's Master Audience Cassettes; Shure SM57 mics > Sony-TC158 [4]
- **gd1979-11-29.set2.sbd.jim.11630.shnf**: taped by Audio CDs compliments of Dr. Sketchy via Stillman; transferred by EAC/SHN by  08/02; source: Soundboard [6]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Marsia Tunis Grateful Dead: [1979-11-29 Cleveland Public Hall, Cleveland, OH, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1979-11-29-cleveland-public-hall-cleveland-oh-usa/) [20]
